snippet.title: Resident Evil Requiem – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
Resident Evil Requiem releases for Nintendo Switch 2 on Feb 27, 2026. Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/resident-evil-requiem-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living.

Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth title in the mainline Resident Evil series. Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

A new era of survival horror begins in 2026.  Technological advancements combined with the development team's depth of experience combine in a story with rich characters and gameplay that's more immersive than ever before.

#ResidentEvilRequiem #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
